name: kynwallet
description: KynWallet monorepo: Angular frontend and NestJS mocked API.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.audit:deps: npm --prefix backend audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.verify: npm run scan:secrets && npm run test && npm run build && npm run audit:deps
